function Dashboard({ user, setPage }) { const [weather, setWeather] = useState({ temp:32, humidity:72, description:"Partly cloudy", city:user.district||"Madurai", windSpeed:3.2, rain:0 }); useEffect(() => { const WKEY = process.env.REACT_APP_WEATHER_API_KEY || ""; if (!WKEY) return; navigator.geolocation?.getCurrentPosition(pos => { fetch(`https://api.openweathermap.org/data/2.5/weather?lat=${pos.coords.latitude}&lon=${pos.coords.longitude}&appid=${WKEY}&units=metric`) .then(r=>r.json()).then(d=>setWeather({ temp:Math.round(d.main.temp), humidity:d.main.humidity, description:d.weather[0].description, city:d.name, windSpeed:d.wind.speed, rain:d.rain?.["1h"]||0 })).catch(()=>{}); }); }, []); const bars = [ { label:"Weather Risk", val:65, c:C.orange }, { label:"Disease Pressure", val:78, c:C.red }, { label:"Soil Health", val:82, c:C.bg2 }, { label:"Pest Alert", val:55, c:C.amber }, ]; return (

👋 Vanakkam, {user.name.split(" ")[0]}!

{user.district}, Tamil Nadu • 21 April 2026

{weather.temp}°C ⛅
{weather.humidity}% humidity • {weather.description}
{[ { l:"Confluence Score", v:"72%", s:"Medium Risk", c:C.orange }, { l:"Active Alerts", v:"3", s:"2 High Priority", c:C.red }, { l:"Crops Tracked", v:user.crops?.length||0, s:"Registered crops", c:C.bg2 }, { l:"Farm Plots", v:user.farms?.length||0, s:"Mapped on GPS", c:C.blue }, ].map(s => (
{s.l}
{s.v}
{s.s}
 ))}

{[ { t:"danger", msg:"Pest: Fall Armyworm spotted in Dindigul — check maize immediately", time:"2h ago" }, { t:"warning", msg:"High humidity next 48hrs — blight risk HIGH for tomato & chilli", time:"5h ago" }, { t:"success", msg:"PM-KISAN 19th installment released — check your bank account", time:"1d ago" }, ].map((a,i) => (
{a.msg}
{a.time}
))}

{bars.map(b => (

))}
